Messages.Author: Luis P. Duarte
Messages.Body:
Hi!
My newsreader somehow had a problem with my own message, so
i couldn't read the answer. Let's try again...

1. What happens to a Vampire with Seeds of Corruption played on him
at superior (not FoS) if he has no blood and must hunt?

2. Who gets the VP's if in a game with 3 players, one "ousts" (kills) both
predator and prey at the same time?

3. If Vampire A plays Carrion Crows and Vampire B plays S:CE, does
Vampire B takes the R damage from CC?

Thanks again.
.- Luis....@ip.pt

Messages.Author: Robert Ekvall
Messages.Body:
> 1. What happens to a Vampire with Seeds of Corruption played on him
> at superior (not FoS) if he has no blood and must hunt?

I'd say that since a vamp with seeds on him/her and at zero blood attempts to
burn 2 blood, fails and continues the hunt action as normal. Same thing with
one blood on the vamp in my opinion. (probably wouldn't hunt though :)

> 2. Who gets the VP's if in a game with 3 players, one "ousts" (kills) both
> predator and prey at the same time?

The one that ousts the other two gets 2VP's. One for him/herself and one for
his/her prey. Prey gets one VP for it's prey.

> 3. If Vampire A plays Carrion Crows and Vampire B plays S:CE, does
> Vampire B takes the R damage from CC?

Nope. Combat ends before the damage resolution phase.

As always, that's to the best of my knowledge. If you want it rock solid
you'll have to wait until LSJ answers.

Rovert

> > predator and prey at the same time?
>
> The one that ousts the other two gets 2VP's. One for him/herself and one for
> his/her prey. Prey gets one VP for it's prey.

Correct. [9.1]

> > 3. If Vampire A plays Carrion Crows and Vampire B plays S:CE, does
> > Vampire B takes the R damage from CC?
>
> Nope. Combat ends before the damage resolution phase.

Correct.
